Can technology prevent next stampede? Inside crowd-monitoring tools India needs
articles.description: The recent stampede in Kolkata has highlighted the urgent need for effective crowd management solutions. Technology, particularly artificial intelligence, can analyze crowd behavior and density in real-time. Implementing digital ticketing and live occupancy data may prevent venues from exceeding safe capacity. An integrated safety network is necessary to connect various crowd-monitoring tools and emergency response teams. Addressing ground-level planning alongside technology will ensure better safety during large gatherings.

articles.title: 'Apologise to Lawrence Bishnoi': After Tiger Shroff attack, fresh warning to Salman
articles.description: An audio recording linked to Anil Pandit has emerged, threatening Salman Khan over an apology. Pandit warned against the safety of Khan's family if he does not comply. The threats follow a recent shooting targeting actor Tiger Shroff's car in Mumbai's Juhu area. Shroff was unharmed, while his driver sustained injuries during the incident. Police are investigating the claims made in the audio and social media posts.

articles.title: Asian Para Games: Kokila assures India of judo medal, sets up gold-medal clash
articles.description: Kokila has triumphed by defeating China's Yi Liu in the para-judo semifinals and is now set to vie for gold against Kyrgyzstan's Aibike Ulanbek Kyzy. Meanwhile, Kapil Parmar is striving for a bronze in the men’s J1 -70kg after a tough semifinal defeat. Additionally, Sheetal Devi equaled the world record in the women's compound ranking round, showcasing India’s impressive prowess at the Asian Para Games.

articles.title: Species Fund Beats Habitat Target: Evaluation finds 4,800ha restored; 51,000 people engaged
articles.description: A transformative £25 million conservation initiative has revitalized wildlife across England. By restoring vast areas and planting over 127,500 trees, the programme fostered community engagement with nature for more than 51,000 individuals. Various projects played a critical role in reconnecting segmented habitats and enhancing wetlands and rivers, underscoring the necessity of strategic investment in preserving thriving ecosystems.

Indiana legal secretary faces 42 felonies over alleged fake court orders and stolen client fees
articles.description: Following a lengthy three-year investigation, Heather Ann Textor, a legal secretary, has been taken into custody for alleged fraudulent activities. She is accused of forging court documents and misappropriating client funds intended for legal fees. The investigation was sparked when a local resident submitted a counterfeit expungement petition to the state police, leading to further scrutiny of suspicious transactions that funneled money into Textor's personal accounts.

articles.title: Stock market today: Sensex tumbles over 450 points, Nifty50 opens below 23,100 mark
articles.full_text: The momentum created by the 2.8 per cent surge in Nifty last week and the good results from the banking majors after the better-than-expected results from the leading IT companies, have the potential to keep the market resilient. However, the escalation of tensions in Hormuz and the consequent surge in Brent crude to USD 109 will act as a strong headwind to the market. October 19 stock picks: Which shares are experts betting on? Dalal Street recorded their strongest weekly performances in approximately six months, extending their recovery amid renewed buying interest in information technology stocks and other heavyweight shares. BSE Sensex climbed 2,256.94 points, or 3.11%, over the week, while NSE Nifty advanced 625.7 points, or 2.77%. The gains followed a sharp rebound in IT stocks after encouraging September-quarter earnings. Ponmudi R, CEO of Enrich Money, said the recovery was supported by renewed buying interest in several heavyweight stocks. The weekly performance put both benchmarks on a stronger footing after recent market weakness. Investors were also looking ahead to further corporate earnings announcements, with the results of major private lenders emerging as an important focus for the next session.

Heightened security risks in the Middle East and the ongoing uncertainty of US-Iran talks are adding to the market's instability.

articles.title: APPSC Group 2 Notification 2026: 686 vacancies announced, applications open November 10
articles.description: APPSC Group 2 Notification 2026: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has announced 686 provisional vacancies under Group 2 Recruitment 2026 through Notification No. 37/2026, released on October 13, 2026. Online applications will open on November 10 and close on November 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM. Vacancies include Deputy Tahsildar, Deputy Mandal Parishad Development Officer and Senior Accountant. Candidates must meet the prescribed educational qualifications and age limit of 18 to 42 years. The screening test date is yet to be announced.

articles.title: Prahaar Box Office: film earns Rs 9 crore in 3 days
articles.description: Rajkummar Rao’s Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story opened slowly on October 16 with Rs 2.35 crore net, rising to Rs 3.15 crore and Rs 3.50 crore over the weekend, totalling Rs 9 crore.
